newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks close up amid buying by retailers.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks close up amid buying by retailers.

text.p: Dhaka stocks closed up as leading scrips in food, cement and leather sectors gained amid retail buying, brokers said.
The Dhaka Stock Exchange all-share price index closed 20.95 points or 1.17 percent up at 1,803.31 on a turnover of 154.8 million taka. Of 121 issues traded 63 gained and 53 lost.

"The market was active as the retail investors showed interest in buying scrips with strong financial base," said one broker. Food stock Pran gained 38 taka to 1,332, Bata Shoe rose 5.80 to 206.88 and Chittagong Cement was up 365 to 5,788.
